parameters.query:
SELECT k.kpi_date, k.transactions, k.transaction_value, k.app_daily_active_users, k.complaints_opened, k.accounts_closed,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM dwh.customer_churn_scores s WHERE s.scored_on = k.kpi_date AND s.risk_band = 'High') AS high_churn_risk,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM dwh.dq_results d WHERE NOT d.passed) AS dq_issues,
       (SELECT round(100.0 * sum(outstanding) FILTER (WHERE ifrs9_stage = 'Stage 3') / sum(outstanding), 2) FROM dwh.mart_portfolio_quality) AS stage3_pct
FROM dwh.mart_kpi_daily k
ORDER BY k.kpi_date DESC
LIMIT 1;
